name: DigitalOcean Startups Program Credits
free_limit: Approved startups receive an individually awarded, one-time DigitalOcean credit allocation toward eligible DigitalOcean infrastructure and AI services for a 12-month startup-program term; the amount is specified in the acceptance/onboarding email, not a public guaranteed sum.
watch_out: Requires a valid DigitalOcean account and approval under the DigitalOcean Startups Program (successor to the discontinued Hatch program). Credit awards and monthly consumption caps are individualized; third-party or excluded services and usage over monthly limits can be billed. Unused credits expire after 12 months and are not extendable under the published program conditions.
